title: "Hackathon"
author: "The Missing Third"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
hackathon_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/fearo/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/Hackathon Fall 2026/nyc_access_clean.csv")
library(stargazer)
```

```{r reg, include=FALSE}
regression1 <- lm(log_access ~ log_income, data = hackathon_data)
regression2 <- lm(log_access ~ log_income + log_density, data = hackathon_data)
regression3 <- lm(log_access ~ log_income + log_density + poverty_pct + youth_pct + older_pct + population, data = hackathon_data)
regression4 <- lm(log_access ~ log_income + log_density + poverty_pct + youth_pct + older_pct + population + log_income * log_density, data = hackathon_data)
```

```{r our table, include=FALSE}
summary(regression1)
summary(regression2)
summary(regression3)
summary(regression4)
```

```{r stargazer table, results='asis', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cat('<div style="display: flex; justify-content: center;">')
stargazer(regression1, regression2, regression3, regression4,
          type = "html",
          title = "Regression Results",
          dep.var.labels = "Log of Access",
          covariate.labels = c("Log of Income", "Log of Density", "Poverty Percentage", "Youth Percentage", "Older Percentage", "Population", "Income/Density Interaction"),
          keep.stat = c("n", "rsq", "adj.rsq"),
          star.cutoffs = c(0.1, 0.05, 0.01))
```
